requirement: Lifecycle work pending at shutdown is explicitly included or excluded

inputs.name: drained
inputs.call: fresh process: godot --headless --path . --script driver.gd (call_deferred + queue_free, then one awaited process_frame before quit)

obligations.note: deferred_method() body -- call_deferred() queues this, it does not run at the call site; reached once the frame drains
NOTIFICATION_PREDELETE fires as part of queue_free()'s actual deletion, which -- like the deferred call -- happens when the frame drains, not synchronously at the queue_free() call site

inputs.name: shutdown_before_drain
inputs.call: fresh process: godot --headless --path . --script driver.gd -- no_drain (call_deferred + queue_free, then quit immediately, no frame drains)

obligations.note: never reached: the process quits before the frame that would have drained the deferred call queue. This is the requirement's core fact -- work that is merely QUEUED at shutdown must be reported as never having run, not credited as executed because it was scheduled.
never reached: queue_free() only queues the deletion, it does not free the object or fire notifications synchronously

notes: Two fresh processes, not two snapshots of one process (same rule established for F041 and F044): a coverage report is cumulative for its own process, so 'this pending work never ran' can only be a real fact in a process that quits before the drain point, never an intermediate snapshot inside a longer-running process that would eventually drain it. Confirmed empirically on the pinned Godot 4.7.1 engine that both call_deferred() and queue_free() queue their work for the end of the current frame rather than running synchronously at the call site -- accessing the node itself after the drained frame is a runtime error (the object has actually been freed by then), so the driver holds a direct reference to the log array captured before queue_free(), not the node.
author: godot-tooling-session-2026-09-19
ambiguities: Only one deferred call and one queue_free() are exercised together in the same frame. A case with multiple deferred calls queued in a specific order, or a queue_free() on a node with children (recursive deletion), is not built here.
